name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Support Specialist | CRM Management, Proposals & Client Documentation

Has built the templates, checklists, and process documentation that keep a team's client work moving without dropped threads, and brings direct competitor and market research experience from technical and business-development work. Comfortable stepping into an existing team's systems and keeping them running accurately during a transition.
